patch_description:
This crossover combines the best aspects of both programs to create a more efficient ansatz. It takes the proven interleaved CZ ring structure from the first program (which showed excellent convergence at step 150) and combines it with the parameter-efficient coarse-grained parameter sharing from the second program. The key improvements are:

1. Maintains the interleaved CZ rings structure that demonstrated faster convergence (150 vs 270 steps)
2. Uses coarse-grained parameter sharing (4 parameters instead of 8) to reduce total parameter count from 74 to 38
3. Keeps the additional chord entanglement (CZ gates between opposite qubits) for better expressivity
4. Preserves the pre/post RZ layer structure for better optimization landscape

This approach balances expressivity with parameter efficiency while maintaining the fast convergence properties of the ring-based architecture.
